title: Structure your Seedance 2.5 prompt like a trailer by breaking it into…
content: Structure your Seedance 2.5 prompt like a trailer by breaking it into scene-by-scene blocks with explicit timing, camera direction, dialogue, sound effects, music cues, and on-screen text.
tips: Structure your Seedance 2.5 prompt like a trailer by breaking it into scene-by-scene blocks with explicit timing, camera direction, dialogue, sound effects, music cues, and on-screen text.

es.content: Estructura tu prompt de Seedance 2.5 como un tráiler, dividiéndolo en bloques escena por escena con timing explícito, dirección de cámara, diálogo, efectos de sonido, indicaciones musicales y texto en pantalla.

fr.content: Structurez votre prompt Seedance 2.5 comme une bande-annonce en le découpant en blocs scène par scène, avec un timing explicite, des indications de caméra, des dialogues, des effets sonores, des cues musicaux et du texte à l’écran.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 の prompt は、予告編のように構成し、シーンごとのブロックに分けて、明確なタイミング、カメラの指示、セリフ、効果音、音楽のキュー、画面上のテキストを含めてください。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5 prompt를 예고편처럼 구성하려면, 장면별 블록으로 나누고 각 블록에 명확한 타이밍, 카메라 방향, 대사, 음향 효과, 음악 큐, 화면 텍스트를 포함하세요.

pt.content: Estruture seu prompt do Seedance 2.5 como um trailer, dividindo-o em blocos cena a cena com timing explícito, direção de câmera, diálogos, efeitos sonoros, indicações musicais e texto na tela.

zh.content: 将你的 Seedance 2.5 prompt 结构化得像一支预告片一样，把它拆分为按场景划分的片段，并明确标注时间、镜头指令、对白、音效、音乐提示和屏幕文字。
